summary.text: Joy San Buenaventura was elected to the Hawaii House of Representatives for District 4 in 2014 and to the Hawaii State Senate for District 2 in 2020.

paragraphs.text: She graduated from McKinley High School, earned a B.S. in mathematics from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and a J.D. from the University of California, Hastings College of the Law.
She was appointed a per diem District Court judge in 1991, and the legislative biography describes her as a 30-year resident of Hawaii Island.
